subject: CAIQ questionnaire normalization and artifact package
messages:
From: Allison Park <apark@tidemed.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@tidemed.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ - normalization and delivery format

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking this on. TideMed's security team kicked off our CAIQ intake and we landed on a slightly different format than the PDF your portal exports. We have a downstream automation that expects a CSV with these columns: control_id, question_text, our_question_reference, redwood_answer, evidence_filenames.

Can you provide the CAIQ responses normalized to that CSV schema and include at least one sample artifact per control type (e.g., S3 policy snippet for storage controls, KV cache retention log for runtime controls)?

Timeline: procurement needs an initial package by EOD Monday Pacific so their legal review can start Tuesday.

Appreciate a quick confirmation and any blockers.

Best,
Allison Park
Security Programs Manager
TideMed

--
Allison Park
Allison.Park@tidemed.com
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Allison Park <apark@tidemed.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ - normalization and delivery format

Allison — thanks for the clear schema. We can produce the CSV and attach representative artifacts. Quick clarifying questions before we assemble:

1) Scope: do you need all CAIQ mappings (full 190+) or only controls within our scoped offering (inference + control plane + telemetry)? We can do a full export but it adds time.
2) Redaction: are there any fields you need redacted (e.g., customer IDs in logs)? We will sanitize before sharing.
3) Evidence delivery: is a single zip + CSV acceptable, or do you want per-control links in a shared Drive?

I can deliver a compact package (CSV + zip) by EOD Monday if you confirm scope = scoped offering and accept sanitized logs. If you need the full matrix, we'd ask for until Wednesday to ensure sampling and legal sign-off.

Irene Choi
Head of Security Operations, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: CAIQ - normalization and delivery format

Priyom / Ben — forwarding TideMed's ask. Procurement wants a CSV-normalized CAIQ and at least one artifact per control type. I proposed a compact package (scoped offering) by EOD Monday.

Can each of you own the following so I can assemble the zip: 
- Priyom: produce the CSV mapping for our scoped CAIQ controls (inference, control plane, telemetry). Use control_id as the primary key and include the short answer snippets we keep in the control registry.
- Ben: gather artifacts & redact PII/customer references. Priority artifacts: S3 bucket policy snippets, KV-cache retention sample logs (first 7 days), runtime telemetry export for a 24-hour window, encryption key rotation proof (kms-rotation-jan2026.pdf).

We should also include a short manifest PDF with the mapping rationale (I will draft). Note: legal asked that all logs be scrubbed of customer IDs and IPs — use token-level hashes where applicable.

Priyom — can you confirm ETA for the CSV? Ben — can you confirm the artifact list and whether the redaction will require additional time?

Thanks,
Irene
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Allison Park <apark@tidemed.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 12:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ - normalization and delivery format

Irene / Ben / Allison — quick status update: 

- CSV: attached (caiq-normalized.csv) — contains 48 rows corresponding to our scoped controls; columns populated per schema (control_id, question_text, our_question_reference, redwood_answer, evidence_filenames). I sampled authoritative snippets from our control registry and added short justifications in the answer cell.
- Artifacts: Ben delivered the artifact zip (artifact-sample-logs.zip) to the shared drive and I referenced filenames in the CSV. All logs have been tokenized and trimmed to 24-hour windows per legal's guidance.
- Manifest: Irene's draft manifest (redwood-evidence-index.pdf) is included in the zip.

Allison — the package is available at the Drive link below for download. If this works we can also generate per-control DocuSign attestation for any claims you want signed.

Drive link: https://app.redwood.ai/drive/collections/caqi-package-4821
DocuSign (optional): https://www.docusign.com/Signing/?s=4821-caiq-ack

If you need the full CAIQ export (190 controls) we can scope that separately — would be about 3 business days.

Thanks,
Priyom

Attachments (referenced): caiq-normalized.csv (CSV), artifact-sample-logs.zip (zip), redwood-evidence-index.pdf (PDF)
